about: Plasma's desktop shell package holds the lock screen (kscreenlocker loads lockscreen/LockScreen.qml from it) and CompactApplet.qml, which opens every panel applet's popup. Its LockScreenUi.qml is replaced by the Windows 11 lock screen in files/lockscreen/ while Plasma's file is the one of plasma-workspace 6.3.6 (Debian 13); CompactApplet.qml (plasma-desktop-data 6.3.6) places the Start menu's popup over the middle of the taskbar; everything else in the shell stays Plasma's.

replacements.why: Windows 11 lock screen: time and date, then account picture and password box
Start opens centred over the taskbar like Windows 11: an empty item in the middle of the panel window (which spans the screen) to place the popup over
the Start menu uses the centred item as its popup's visual parent
flyouts slide in from the taskbar like Windows 11 (KWin's sliding popups effect)
